theater: 鄂州城與長江下游江面

battle.name: 鄂州之戰
battle.theater: 鄂州城與長江下游江面
battle.brief: 元憲宗八年（一二五八年）冬，忽必烈率東路蒙古軍南下，抵鄂州（武昌）後合圍，與宋將高達隔江對峙；元軍立配重回回砲，連日擊毀城樓雉堞，宋廷遣張禧率援軍至銅陵、池州之間，被董文炳擊潰。正月汪德臣病逝軍中，七月蒙哥汗死於釣魚山，蒙古軍退走，鄂州未下。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰一方是南宋。鄂州為荊湖北路首府，州治在江夏縣即今武昌，扼漢水入江之口，控江東西往，是南宋長江中游防線的樞紐；元軍若取鄂州，江陵、岳州、江南一線洞開，南方根本受震，故鄂州在宋廷眼中是必守之城。防守由荊湖宣撫司、鄂州知州與沿江制置司分掌，守軍以殿前司禁軍、鄂州兵與民兵為骨幹，弓弩手、投石手、匠役編入城防序列，命令自樞密院逐級下達，江上援軍由兩淮、荊湖各處抽調，調齊動員往往需時月。另一方是蒙古帝國：元憲宗八年（一二五八年）分兵伐宋，蒙哥汗自將西路入蜀，攻釣魚城；忽必烈總兵漠南漢地軍，領東路南下，尋道河南、江北，前鋒抵鄂州即四面合圍，攻城諸具由隨軍漢軍匠人與西域砲匠造辦，糧秣自襄陽、隨州一線的北路運下。兩邊的戰法正好相反：宋廷把鄂州當可守之城，靠城牆、弩手與長江天塹死守待援；蒙古把它當必過的門戶，先合圍斷援，再以配重砲與水軍同時施壓。同一座城，一邊算的是守到援軍到來，一邊算的是耗到對方自己退走。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the Southern Song. Ezhou was the seat of the Jinghuai circuit, its prefectural seat at Jiangxia county, that is today's Wuchang, commanding the mouth of the Han River where it enters the Yangtze and controlling traffic along the river, and it was the pivot of the Southern Song's middle Yangtze defence line. If the Mongols took Ezhou, the line of Jiangling, Yuezhou and the Jiangnan would open and the southern heart of the realm would be shaken, so in the eyes of the Song court Ezhou was a city that had to be held. The defence was divided among the Jinghuai pacification commission, the prefect of Ezhou and the river command posts, and the garrison rested on the palace guards, the Ezhou troops and the local militia, with crossbowmen, stone-throwers and craftsmen entered into the city defence establishment, orders running downward from the Privy Council, and river-borne relief drawn from Lianghuai and Jinghuai alike, so that concentrating such a force took months. The other side was the Mongol Empire. In 1258, the eighth year of the reign of Möngke Khan, the Mongols split their forces against the Song: Möngke took the western road into Sichuan to attack Diaoyu City, while Kublai, holding command of the southern troops of the Chinese lands, led the eastern column down through Henan and north of the river, and as soon as the vanguard reached Ezhou the city was encircled on all four sides, the siege engines built by Han craftsmen and western gunners carried in the army, and the grain hauled down the northern road through Xiangyang and Suizhou. The two ways of fighting were exact opposites. The Song court treated Ezhou as a city that could be held, trusting the wall, the crossbowmen and the river barrier to hold out until help came; the Mongols treated it as a gate that had to be passed, cutting off relief first and then pressing with the counterweighted trebuchet and the fleet at the same time. Over the same city, one side counted on holding out until the relief army arrived, the other on grinding until the other side withdrew of its own accord.
people: 忽必烈是東路的主帥，他不急於強攻，一二五八年冬抵鄂州後即分兵四面合圍，斷宋援兵之路，又屢遣使與南宋議和，試圖以歲幣換取稱臣，讓攻城不必流血。劉整是全場最關鍵的技術與情報來源：他原為南宋四川制置副使，一二五八年以蜀地降元，帶來蜀中兵員、糧道與宋人江防的內部知識，又力主先取全蜀、斷宋之援、並力攻鄂；據《元史·劉整傳》，他在鄂州主張在城下游江面架浮橋渡江，宋人坐視橋成而不敢擊，劉整因而判斷可乘勢濟江。董文炳是東路先鋒主將之一，他率舟師溯江而上，設水寨護住砲位，用配重砲攻城，並在銅陵、池州之間擊潰宋廷援軍主帥張禧，張禧陣亡。汪德臣是蒙哥汗最信任的漢族將領、鞏昌路總帥，他率兵來援鄂州，一二五九年正月病逝軍中，年五十二，蒙哥汗聞訊震悼，追贈太師、追封雍國公。南宋方面，樞密院權臣賈似道奉命督師江上，一二五九年抵鄂州主持防務，又與元方議和；城未破而蒙哥汗七月死於釣魚山，蒙古軍北撤，賈似道卻偽報大捷，朝廷事後追論其鄂州和議與瞞報之罪。守將高達在江上與蒙古相持，賈似道反歸罪其不能禦敵，士論譏之。郝經以蒙古國信使身分自鄂州南下議和，被宋拘留於潭州，數年不得歸。
peopleEn: Kublai was the commander of the eastern column, and he was in no hurry to assault. When he reached Ezhou in the winter of 1258 he at once divided the army to encircle the city on all sides, cutting the road by which Song relief could come, and he sent envoys more than once to negotiate, hoping to buy a general submission in return for tribute and so spare the city a bloody storming. Liu Zheng was the decisive source of technical and intelligence knowledge in the whole affair. He had been the Southern Song deputy pacification commissioner of Sichuan, and in 1258 he came over to the Mongols with the Sichuan forces, bringing men, grain routes and inside knowledge of the Song's river defences, and he pressed for taking all of Sichuan first, cutting the Song's sources of men, and then concentrating on Ezhou. According to the Yuan History biography of Liu Zheng, at Ezhou he argued for a floating bridge across the river below the city so that the army could cross; the Song watched the bridge go up and did not dare attack it, and Liu Zheng accordingly judged that the moment had come to cross the river. Dong Wenbing was one of the leaders of the vanguard: he brought the fleet up the river, set floating camps to shield the gun positions, battered the city with the counterweighted trebuchet, and between Tongling and Chizhou broke the Song relief army commanded by Zhang Xi, who was killed. Wang Dechen was a Han Chinese general whom Möngke trusted above all, the commander of Gongchang; he came to relieve Ezhou and died of illness in the camp in the first month of 1259, at the age of fifty-two, and Möngke was stricken by the news and posthumously granted the rank of Grand Preceptor and the title of Prince of Yong. On the Song side the chancellor Jia Sidao, who controlled the Privy Council, was sent to the river front to direct the war; he reached Ezhou in 1259 and took charge of the defence, and he also opened negotiations with the Mongol side. The city was not broken, and in the seventh month Möngke Khan died at Diaoyu Mountain and the Mongol army withdrew north, yet Jia Sidao reported a great victory to the court; the court afterwards called him to account for the Ezhou settlement and for the false report. The garrison commander Gao Da held the river against the Mongols, and Jia Sidao turned on him instead, blaming him for not checking the enemy, which the officer corps resented. Hao Jing went south from Ezhou as the Mongol envoy to treat for peace, was detained by the Song at Tanzhou, and did not return for years.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車是長臂配重式拋石機：長臂一端繫兜盛石，另一端懸配重，發射時配重下沉、甩臂揚起，兜中石塊被拋越城牆而砸入城内，射程與拋重都遠超人力扯動的傳統拋石車。在鄂州之戰的體系裡，它是蒙古攻城的主砲，也是宋人最怕的東西。元軍在江邊高處立起配重回回砲，一發可中城樓與雉堞，砲身高數丈，需數十乃至數百人牽拉裝石、復位，兩發之間常隔數日，故攻城節奏被迫放慢；但砲一響，宋城頭的射位便要遷徙，宋弩手居高臨下的射界被砲火壓住。與之配合的還有元軍的弩手、弓箭手與水軍舟師：舟師以木船排成水寨，護住砲位不被宋舟逼近，弩手沿岸齊射，掩護砲手裝填。攻城具方面有雲梯、撞車、懸梯、闢毒飛煙與穿甲椎之屬，多由隨軍漢軍匠人打造。南宋方面，守城以弩、弓、投石車與城頭木柵為主，江上另有水軍大艦、蒙衝艦與車船，用以封鎖江面、衝擊浮橋與水寨；此外南宋在長江防線上已配置早期火器如突火槍與火砲一類，數量極少，仍屬新奇之器而非主力。同一場戰役裡，兩個技術體系都擺上了城牆：蒙古靠配重砲壓制，宋靠弩陣與水軍固守。
kitsEn: The counterweighted trebuchet on the card is the long-arm counterweight type: a sling of stone at one end of a long arm, a counterweight hanging at the other, and when the machine is released the weight drops, the arm whips upward, and the stone in the sling is thrown over the wall and into the town, its range and its weight of stone far exceeding that of the traditional traction trebuchet worked by manpower alone. In the system of the siege of Ezhou it was the Mongols' principal gun and the thing the Song most feared. The Mongol army set up counterweighted huihui pao on high ground along the river, a single shot able to strike a gate tower and the crenellations; the frame stood several zhang high, loading the stone and resetting the arm took dozens and at times hundreds of men hauling at the windlass, and two shots were commonly a day or more apart, so the pace of the assault was forced to slow. But when the engine spoke, the Song firing positions on the parapet had to shift, and the archers' line of fire from the wall was crushed by the bombardment. Working with it were the Mongol crossbowmen and archers on the shore and the fleet on the river: the boats were lashed into floating camps to shield the gun positions from the Song vessels, and the crossbowmen fired in unison along the bank to cover the crews while they loaded. Among the other siege engines were scaling ladders, battering rams, hanging ladders, smoke pots for poisoning the defenders and pick-like tools for breaking armour, most of them made by Han craftsmen carried in the army. On the Song side the defence of the wall rested on crossbows, bows, stone-throwers and wooden palisades along the parapet, while on the river the Song fleet had large warships, ram-ships and wheeled barges, used to close the river and to strike the floating bridge and the camps. The Southern Song had also begun to place early gunpowder devices such as the tuohu qiang and the fire bomb on its river defences, but the numbers were very small and they remained novel instruments rather than main armaments. In this one battle two technological systems both came up against the wall: the Mongols relied on the counterweighted trebuchet to suppress, the Song on the crossbow line and the fleet to hold.
tactics: 蒙古的戰法是圍城打援、合水陸兩線：先以輕騎與漢軍切斷江漢之間的陸路，斷宋援軍北上之路，再以舟師在長江上佈水寨，封住鄂州的江面出入；然後把配重砲架在城北與城西的土築高處，晝夜轟擊，逼宋軍在城頭疲於躲藏，同時反覆出城列陣，試圖衝擊砲位與水寨。砲火是全場的節拍器：宋軍每把援兵、糧船或兵員調動到城頭或江面的一段區域，元軍即以砲火覆蓋那一段，迫使其改在夜間移動。破壞水寨與浮橋是宋軍的主要反擊手段，江上水軍屢次駛出，用撞杆、火矢與蒙衝艦衝擊正在施工的浮橋與木寨。援軍由張禧率領自江東北上，兵至銅陵、池州之間即遭董文炳水陸夾擊，潰散於江岸與原野，江面上浮屍與沉船相連。城內則靠城頭射界與內城縱深消耗時間：宋廷屢遣援兵、屢下詔令固守，卻沒有一支能突破蒙古的封鎖線，糧船一到江面便被截。蒙古自身的進攻次序也講究：先砲後梯、先水後陸，不急於登城，而是把宋廷的援軍一一吃掉，等於先在城牆外贏了消耗戰。攻城最終未竟，靠的不是城破，而是宋廷中樞的混亂與蒙古本部主力的西撤。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method was to invest the city, to destroy its relief, and to work both on water and on land at once. Light cavalry and Han troops first cut the roads between the Han and the Yangtze so that no Song relief could move north; the fleet was then set into floating camps on the Yangtze to close the river entrances of Ezhou; and only then were the counterweighted trebuchets planted on earthen heights north and west of the city to bombard day and night, forcing the Song to spend their time ducking on the parapet, while repeated sorties were launched out of the gates to try to run down the gun positions and the floating camps. The bombardment was the metronome of the whole siege: every time the Song moved troops, grain ships or supplies into one stretch of parapet or river, the Mongols covered that stretch with stone, forcing the movement to be made at night instead. Breaking the floating camps and the bridge was the Song's principal counter-stroke: the river fleet went out again and again, using rams, fire arrows and ram-ships against the bridge and the camps as they were being built. The relief army led by Zhang Xi moved up the river from the east and was caught between Dong Wenbing's troops on the water and on the land between Tongling and Chizhou, scattering along the bank and across the fields, with the dead and the sunken boats lying together on the water. Inside the city the defence consumed time on the parapet and in the depth of the inner town: the court sent relief again and again and issued edicts to hold, but not one column ever broke through the Mongol cordon, and grain ships were intercepted as soon as they showed on the river. The Mongol order of attack was deliberate as well: guns before ladders, water before land, no hurry to scale the wall, and the Song relief armies taken one by one, which was to say that the war of attrition had already been won outside the wall. The siege ended without the city falling, and what ended it was not a breach but the confusion in the Song court and the withdrawal of the Mongol main body westward.
data: 時間上有較確的刻度：元憲宗八年（一二五八年）秋忽必烈率東路軍南下，同年冬抵鄂州並合圍，至元憲宗九年（一二五九年）正月汪德臣病逝、七月蒙哥汗死於釣魚城，蒙古軍於八、九月間撤圍北上，鄂州城未被攻破，圍城歷時約八個月。正月汪德臣卒年五十二。器械與城防方面：《元史》記元軍在鄂州配用回回砲，一發可中城樓與雉堞，砲身高數丈，裝填須眾人牽拉，兩發之間相隔數日；宋軍江防有木船、蒙衝艦與車船，蒙古軍在城下游架浮橋，以木橋與舟船相接，橋成之後元軍得以渡江南下。兵力數字各家說法不一：宋廷屢發援軍，張禧一路即統兵數萬北上；元廷此役分道出兵，兵員合計在數十萬量級，攻城當面之眾當在數萬以上；鄂州守軍連同民兵，則有數萬之說。距離上，鄂州城至江心的水面寬約數百步至數里，蒙古軍選的渡越點在城下游，與宋軍主力隔一江相望。兩個關鍵時點：正月折元軍一柱石，七月令整場圍城中止。
dataEn: The chronology can be fixed with fair confidence. In the autumn of 1258 Kublai led the eastern column south, in the same winter he reached Ezhou and the city was encircled, in the first month of 1259 Wang Dechen died, in the seventh month Möngke Khan died at Diaoyu Mountain, and in the eighth and ninth months the Mongol army lifted the siege and marched north; Ezhou was never taken, and the investment lasted about eight months. Wang Dechen was fifty-two years old when he died. On the weapons and the works, the Yuan History records that the Mongol army used the huihui pao at Ezhou, that a single shot could strike a gate tower and the crenellations, that the frame stood several zhang high, that loading required a crowd of men at the windlass, and that two shots were often several days apart. The Song defences on the river included wooden ships, ram-ships and wheeled barges, and the Mongols built a floating bridge below the city, joining plank spans to boats so that once it was finished the army could cross the river to the south. The numbers of troops are given differently by different sources: the Song court sent relief repeatedly, and the column under Zhang Xi alone was counted in thousands upon thousands of men; the Mongol court divided its force into several columns, the total on the order of several hundreds of thousands, with the force actually engaged before the city certainly in the tens of thousands; the Ezhou garrison together with the militia is also put at tens of thousands. As to distance, the water between the city of Ezhou and the middle of the river was several hundred paces to several li across, and the crossing the Mongols chose lay below the city, facing the main body of the Song army across a single river. Two moments mattered above the others: the first month, when the Mongols lost a pillar of their army, and the seventh month, when the whole siege stopped.
cause: 打起來有三層原因。第一層是元廷非打不可：元憲宗元年（一二五六年）忽必烈即位後，北方與中原已無大障，滅宋是解決南宋、西夏、吐蕃並立格局的唯一辦法；此前一二五七年蒙古東路曾攻鄂州不克、又在真州一役失利退兵，元廷不接受再吃一次這樣的敗仗，於是一二五八年再分四道大舉入宋。第二層是南宋自己把空隙留出來了：賈似道主政時以和代戰，用歲幣換取蒙古退兵，襄淮之間的防線空虛，江防鬆懈，而鄂州正落在這段鬆動處；同時文臣居樞密院之位，軍令與援軍調度互不配合，邊將與朝廷互相掣肘。第三層是技術與人事的合流：劉整以四川降元，帶來蜀中的兵員與糧道，也帶來宋人江防的內部情報，他力主先取全蜀、再併力東下；元廷也算得很清楚，鄂州是長江中游的鑰匙，取鄂州則江陵、岳州、江南在握，不取鄂州則長江天塹橫在南北之間，南朝就永遠保得住屏障。於是雙方都把兵鋒壓在同一座江邊的城上，只是雙方對這座城的讀法完全不同。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason for the war. First, the Mongol court had no choice but to fight. After Kublai took the throne in 1256 there was no longer a serious obstacle in the north or in the central plain, and destroying the Song was the only way to settle a world in which Song, Xixia and Tibet stood side by side. In 1257 the eastern Mongol army had failed to take Ezhou and had been beaten at Zhenzhou, and the Mongol court would not swallow a defeat of that kind twice, so in 1258 the force was split into several columns and sent into the Song again. Second, the Song had left the opening itself. Under Jia Sidao the court governed by making peace rather than by fighting, buying the withdrawal of the Mongols with tribute, leaving the line between Xiangyang and Huai empty and the river defence slack, and Ezhou lay exactly in that slack place; and at the same time civil officials held the chair at the Privy Council, so that military orders and the movement of relief did not work together and the frontier commanders and the court pulled against one another. Third, technology and personnel came together. Liu Zheng came over to the Mongols with Sichuan, bringing the men and the grain of Sichuan and also the inside knowledge of the Song's river defences, and he pressed for taking all of Sichuan and then driving east in full force. And the Mongol calculation was plain: Ezhou was the key of the middle Yangtze; take Ezhou and Jiangling, Yuezhou and the Jiangnan were in hand, leave Ezhou alone and the river barrier would stand between north and south, and the southern court would keep its shield for ever. So both sides pressed their weight onto the same city on the river, reading that city in entirely different ways.
impact: 鄂州沒有打下，卻改變了兩個政權的命運，也改變了攻城技術的分量。對蒙古而言，這場圍城把配重回回砲的威力第一次完整展示在長江中游的大城之下：砲能摧城樓，卻不能斷糧、不能渡江、也不能救主，蒙哥汗一死，整個攻城機器在幾天內解體南下，這說明機械再強，也要靠後方與指揮支撐。對南宋而言，這是一場僥倖的守城：鄂州頂住了半年，消耗了元軍最精銳的東路兵力的時間，卻讓江漢防線在往後十年仍然成立；而後來的襄樊之戰、鄂州再失、臨安出降，都從這條防線的一環開始裂開。技術上，這是配重砲在中國大型城池前的一次實戰記錄，也是弩砲對抗的樣板：宋軍以弩陣覆蓋城頭、以水軍護江，把蒙古的砲火限制在城頭；蒙古以砲火加封鎖，把宋軍的援軍逐漸切斷，砲與弩第一次在同一道城牆上量過長短。往後的走向也由此分岔：蒙古此後把回回砲與築壘封鎖結合南下，攻城辦法越來越倚重器械與工程；南宋則在火器上加緊試製，突火槍、火砲一類新兵器逐步出現在江防與城頭。此戰還牽動了外交：郝經被扣潭州，宋蒙之間的使節往來斷續數年，議和的門一直沒有真正打開。
impactEn: Ezhou did not fall, and yet the siege changed the fortunes of both states and changed the weight of siege engines. For the Mongols this was the first complete display, before a great city of the middle Yangtze, of what the counterweighted huihui pao could do: the engine could break a gate tower, but it could not cut the grain, could not bridge the river and could not save a commander, and when Möngke died the whole siege machine came apart within days and marched south, which showed that no machine is strong enough without the rear and the command behind it. For the Song it was a lucky defence: Ezhou held for half a year and consumed the time of the finest troops in the Mongol eastern column, and the Han River line survived the next ten years on that strength; and the later siege of Xiangyang and Fancheng, the second loss of Ezhou and the surrender of Lin'an all begin with a joint coming loose in one part of this line. In technical terms this was a field record of the counterweighted trebuchet before a major Chinese city, and also a set model of the duel between the bolt and the stone: the Song covered the parapet with crossbow line and guarded the river with the fleet, holding the Mongol bombardment to the top of the wall, while the Mongols combined the bombardment with blockade and cut the Song relief off piece by piece, the gun and the crossbow measuring each other for the first time over the same wall. What followed branched in two directions. The Mongols thereafter combined the huihui pao with entrenchment and blockade as they marched south, and siege grew ever more dependent on engines and engineering; the Song pressed on with experiments in gunpowder, and instruments such as the tuohu qiang and the fire bomb began to appear on the river defences and on the walls. The war also touched diplomacy: Hao Jing was held at Tanzhou, envoys passed to and fro between Song and Mongol for years without a settled peace, and the door of negotiation was never truly opened.
result: 結果是鄂州未下，元軍退兵。蒙古沒有攻破城牆，卻已經把鄂州變成一座斷了外援、難以久守的城：張禧一路援軍在銅陵、池州之間潰散，糧道與援兵在城外被切斷，城內糧秣一日緊過一日。正月汪德臣之死先抽走一根樑柱，七月蒙哥汗在四川釣魚山下病逝的消息傳到江邊，軍中人心立散，忽必烈率東路軍回援西路，圍城解。鄂州守軍守住了城，但南宋的代價在別處：賈似道主持的鄂州和議條件苛刻而被元廷拒絕，事後他偽報元軍大敗而退、蒙哥已死的捷報，朝廷追論其罪，一二五九年十月他被罷相貶謫，開慶元年的這一局成為南宋中樞分崩的開端。對蒙古而言，失去的是半年的時間、汪德臣一柱石與一批攻城砲手匠人；對南宋而言，失去的是一個可以拿來宣講的真相：鄂州其實是靠對方主將病死而解圍，而不是靠自己的守城戰術取勝。配重投石車在這場戰役裡展示了它的極限，它能拆掉城頭，卻拆不掉糧道、拆不掉援兵，也拆不掉遠方主將的死亡。
resultEn: The outcome was that Ezhou was not taken and the Mongol army withdrew. The Mongols had not broken the wall, but they had already turned Ezhou into a city cut off from help and unable to hold for long: the relief army under Zhang Xi scattered between Tongling and Chizhou, the grain route and the relief columns were cut off outside the walls, and the food inside the city grew shorter every day. The death of Wang Dechen in the first month took out one of the pillars first; in the seventh month the news that Möngke Khan had died of illness at Diaoyu Mountain in Sichuan reached the river, the army's heart failed at once, and Kublai led the eastern column back to support the western one, and the siege was lifted. The Song held the city, but the Song paid the price elsewhere. The terms of the settlement Jia Sidao had negotiated at Ezhou were harsh and the Mongol court refused them; afterwards he reported the false news that the Mongol army had been destroyed and that Möngke was dead, the court called him to account, and in the tenth month of 1259 he was dismissed from office and sent away in disgrace, and that business at the opening of the Kaixing era became the beginning of the dissolution of the Song centre. For the Mongols the loss was six months of time, one pillar in the person of Wang Dechen, and a set of gunners and craftsmen; for the Song the loss was a truth that could have been told and was not, because Ezhou had been relieved by the death of a distant enemy commander and not by its own art of defence. The counterweighted trebuchet showed the limit of its power in this war: it could knock down the parapet, but it could not knock down the grain route, could not knock down the relief army, and could not knock down the death of a commander far away.
